content.comment_body: Hello all! Yes, the [product_name] 12/24RC(o), 24RC(o) and 230RC(o) models include potential-free relay outputs. The internal program only closes the relay contacts. For example, you can connect an AC voltage like 220V to one side of the Q1 relay, and when the relay is activated, that voltage becomes available to the connected circuit. Similarly, Q2 can have 12V DC on one side, which gets delivered to the circuit when the relay is switched by the program. This applies to all relay outputs, including those on [product_name] expansion modules, though the current is limited to 5A on expansions. The main module relays support up to 10A AC current, whereas for DC current, it's best to stay below 8A for longer relay lifespan. Hi [user_name], are the relay output characteristics similar for [product_name] CPU 224?
Thread is closed since a duplicate question about outputs for [product_name] CPU 224 already exists. Best regards, [user_name]
